title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1122 | 跳绳破纪录、会变强的果冻、巨型气球游行
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🪢 日本少年跳绳破世界纪录，一跳绳子转五圈！
🧪 糖做的果冻越捏越结实，弯一万次也不断！
🎈 感恩节大游行来啦，巨型布鲁伊气球有五层楼高！

📖 Word of the day: gigantic（巨大的）

🎮 二选一：骑上巨型布鲁伊气球飞越纽约，还是跳绳快到一跳转五圈？快问问爸爸妈妈选哪个！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🪢 A boy in Japan spins the rope five times in one jump, thirty nine times in a row — a world record!
🧪 A jelly made from sugar gets stronger every time you squish it!
🎈 The one hundredth Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is coming, with a Bluey balloon as tall as a five story building!

📖 Word of the day: gigantic

🎮 Would you rather ride a gigantic Bluey balloon, or jump rope so fast the rope spins five times in one jump?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. gigantic（巨大的）
Gigantic means really, really big.
例：The Bluey balloon is gigantic!（布鲁伊气球巨大无比！）

2. skip（跳绳）
When you skip rope, you jump over a rope again and again.
例：Let us skip rope together!（我们一起跳绳吧！）

3. jelly（果冻；凝胶）
Jelly is a soft, wobbly, squishy thing.
例：The jelly gets stronger when you squish it.（果冻越捏越结实。）

4. squish（挤压；捏扁）
When you squish something, you squeeze it softly.
例：Squish the jelly and it gets stronger!（捏一捏果冻，它就变得更结实！）
